title: Claims Administration Standards for Pass and Trip Protection
content:
The claims side of Pass and Trip Protection works to the periods, papers and settlement routes scheduled
below. Each figure belongs to the plan the claim is made on and to no other.

| Plan | Notice period (calendar days) | Submission period for papers (calendar days) | Papers the plan requires | Doctor's certificate required | Employer's letter required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 30 | 21 | Claim form; doctor's certificate | Yes | No |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 45 | 30 | Claim form; doctor's certificate; employer's letter | Yes | Yes |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 60 | 45 | Claim form; doctor's certificate; employer's letter; proof of a permanent move | Yes | Yes |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 30 | 21 | Claim form; doctor's certificate; booking confirmation | Yes | No |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 45 | 30 | Claim form; doctor's certificate; employer's letter; booking confirmation | Yes | Yes |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 90 | 60 | Claim form; doctor's certificate; employer's letter; proof of a permanent move; booking confirmation | Yes | Yes |

| Plan | Complete claim assessed within (business days) | Payout reaches the household within (business days) | Route the payout goes by | Appeal to the protection panel | Appeal made within (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 15 | 10 | Resort credit | Not allowed | 0 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 12 | 10 | Resort credit | Allowed | 30 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 10 | 7 | The original payment method | Allowed | 45 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 12 | 10 | Resort credit | Allowed | 30 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 8 | 7 | The original payment method | Allowed | 45 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 3 | 3 | Bank transfer | Allowed | 90 |

**Basis questions answered by this schedule.** Which papers does a plan require? Those its own row names, and
a doctor's certificate is required on all six. Which plans take an employer's letter? Season Pass Protection
Plus, Season Pass Protection Premier, Collective Trip Protection Elite and the Collective Total Protection
Concierge plan. May a refusal be appealed? On every plan but Season Pass Protection Basic, which allows no
appeal and carries an appeal period of 0 days.
